neighbours.label: word-initial ' sh' piece (shabby, shoddy) and similar short word-start fragments
fire: The old hotel looked a little shabby from the street.
The repairs were shoddy and the roof leaked again.
Their storage area was shoddy and badly organized.
Compared with the new museum, the old one seems shabby.
He wore a shabby coat with holes in the sleeves.
The builders did shoddy work on the stairs.
The waiting room was shabby but clean.
Critics called the film's special effects shoddy.
quiet: The old hotel looked a little dark from the street.
The repairs were cheap and the roof leaked again.
Their storage area was small and badly organized.
Compared with the new museum, the old one seems quiet.
He wore a long coat with holes in the sleeves.
The builders did careful work on the stairs.
The waiting room was small but clean.
Critics called the film's special effects cheap.
